class.name: OcgV3dView
class.brief_description: Defines the application object VIEW for the VIEWER application. The methods of this class allow the editing and inquiring the parameters linked to the view. Provides a set of services common to all types of view. Warning: The default parameters are defined by the class Viewer (Example : SetDefaultViewSize()). Certain methods are mouse oriented, and it is necessary to know the difference between the start and the continuation of this gesture in putting the method into operation. Example : Shifting the eye-view along the screen axes.
class.description: ! Defines the application object VIEW for the ! VIEWER application. ! The methods of this class allow the editing ! and inquiring the parameters linked to the view. ! Provides a set of services common to all types of view. ! Warning: The default parameters are defined by the class ! Viewer (Example : SetDefaultViewSize()). ! Certain methods are mouse oriented, and it is ! necessary to know the difference between the start and ! the continuation of this gesture in putting the method ! into operation. ! Example : Shifting the eye-view along the screen axes. ! ! View->Move(10.,20.,0.,True) (Starting motion) ! View->Move(15.,-5.,0.,False) (Next motion)

method.name: from_1
method.description: Initializes the view.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Initializes the view by copying.

method.name: Remove
method.description: Destroys the view.

method.name: Update
method.description: Deprecated, Redraw() should be used instead.

method.name: Redraw
method.description: Redisplays the view even if there has not been any modification. Must be called if the view is shown. (Ex: DeIconification ) .

method.name: RedrawImmediate
method.description: Updates layer of immediate presentations.

method.name: Invalidate
method.description: Invalidates view content but does not redraw it.

method.name: IsInvalidated
method.description: Returns true if cached view content has been invalidated.

method.name: IsInvalidatedImmediate
method.description: Returns true if immediate layer content has been invalidated.

method.name: InvalidateImmediate
method.description: Invalidates view content within immediate layer but does not redraw it.

method.name: MustBeResized
method.description: Must be called when the window supporting the view changes size. if the view is not mapped on a window. Warning: The view is centered and resized to preserve the height/width ratio of the window.

method.name: DoMapping
method.description: Must be called when the window supporting the view is mapped or unmapped.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Returns the status of the view regarding the displayed structures inside Returns True is The View is empty

method.name: UpdateLights
method.description: Updates the lights of the view.

method.name: SetAutoZFitMode
method.description: Sets the automatic z-fit mode and its parameters. The auto z-fit has extra parameters which can controlled from application level to ensure that the size of viewing volume will be sufficiently large to cover the depth of unmanaged objects, for example, transformation persistent ones.

method.name: AutoZFitMode
method.description: returns TRUE if automatic z-fit mode is turned on.

method.name: AutoZFitScaleFactor
method.description: returns scale factor parameter of automatic z-fit mode.

method.name: AutoZFit
method.description: If automatic z-range fitting is turned on, adjusts Z-min and Z-max projection volume planes with call to ZFitAll.

method.name: ZFitAll
method.description: Change Z-min and Z-max planes of projection volume to match the displayed objects.

method.name: SetBackgroundColor_2
method.description: Defines the background color of the view by the color definition type and the three corresponding values.

method.name: SetBackgroundColor_1
method.description: Defines the background color of the view.

method.name: SetBgGradientColors
method.description: Defines the gradient background colors of the view by supplying the colors and the fill method (horizontal by default).

method.name: SetBgGradientStyle
method.description: Defines the gradient background fill method of the view.

method.name: SetBackgroundImage_1
method.description: Defines the background texture of the view by supplying the texture image file name and fill method (centered by default).

method.name: SetBackgroundImage_2
method.description: Defines the background texture of the view by supplying the texture and fill method (centered by default)

method.name: SetBgImageStyle
method.description: Defines the textured background fill method of the view.

method.name: SetBackgroundCubeMap
method.description: Sets environment cubemap as background.

method.name: BackgroundSkydome
method.description: Returns skydome aspect;

method.name: SetBackgroundSkydome
method.description: Sets skydome aspect

method.name: IsImageBasedLighting
method.description: Returns TRUE if IBL (Image Based Lighting) from background cubemap is enabled.

method.name: SetImageBasedLighting
method.description: Enables or disables IBL (Image Based Lighting) from background cubemap. Has no effect if PBR is not used.

method.name: GeneratePBREnvironment
method.description: Activates IBL from background cubemap.

method.name: ClearPBREnvironment
method.description: Disables IBL from background cubemap; fills PBR specular probe and irradiance map with white color.

method.name: SetTextureEnv
method.description: Sets the environment texture to use. No environment texture by default.

method.name: SetAxis
method.description: Definition of an axis from its origin and its orientation . This will be the current axis for rotations and movements. Warning! raises BadValue from V3d if the vector normal is NULL. .

method.name: SetVisualization
method.description: Defines the visualization type in the view.

method.name: SetLightOn_2
method.description: Activates theLight in the view.

method.name: SetLightOn_1
method.description: Activates all the lights defined in this view.

method.name: SetLightOff_2
method.description: Deactivate theLight in this view.

method.name: SetLightOff_1
method.description: Deactivate all the Lights defined in this view.

method.name: IsActiveLight
method.description: Returns TRUE when the light is active in this view.

method.name: SetImmediateUpdate
method.description: sets the immediate update mode and returns the previous one.

method.name: Trihedron
method.description: Returns trihedron object.

method.name: ZBufferTriedronSetup
method.description: Customization of the ZBUFFER Triedron. XColor,YColor,ZColor - colors of axis SizeRatio - ratio of decreasing of the trihedron size when its physical position comes out of the view AxisDiametr - diameter relatively to axis length NbFacettes - number of facets of cylinders and cones

method.name: TriedronDisplay
method.description: Display of the Triedron. Initialize position, color and length of Triedron axes. The scale is a percent of the window width.

method.name: TriedronErase
method.description: Erases the Triedron.

method.name: GetGraduatedTrihedron
method.description: Returns data of a graduated trihedron.

method.name: GraduatedTrihedronDisplay
method.description: Displays a graduated trihedron.

method.name: GraduatedTrihedronErase
method.description: Erases a graduated trihedron from the view.

method.name: SetFront
method.description: modify the Projection of the view perpendicularly to the privileged plane of the viewer.

method.name: Rotate_3
method.description: Rotates the eye about the coordinate system of reference of the screen for which the origin is the view point of the projection, with a relative angular value in RADIANS with respect to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True Warning! raises BadValue from V3d If the eye, the view point, or the high point are aligned or confused.

method.name: Rotate_5
method.description: Rotates the eye about the coordinate system of reference of the screen for which the origin is Gravity point {X,Y,Z}, with a relative angular value in RADIANS with respect to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True If the eye, the view point, or the high point are aligned or confused.

method.name: Rotate_4
method.description: Rotates the eye about one of the coordinate axes of of the view for which the origin is the Gravity point{X,Y,Z} with an relative angular value in RADIANS with respect to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: Rotate_2
method.description: Rotates the eye about one of the coordinate axes of of the view for which the origin is the view point of the projection with an relative angular value in RADIANS with respect to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: Rotate_1
method.description: Rotates the eye around the current axis a relative angular value in RADIANS with respect to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: Move_3
method.description: Movement of the eye parallel to the coordinate system of reference of the screen a distance relative to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True.

method.name: Move_2
method.description: Movement of the eye parallel to one of the axes of the coordinate system of reference of the view a distance relative to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True.

method.name: Move_1
method.description: Movement of the eye parllel to the current axis a distance relative to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: Translate_3
method.description: Movement of the ye and the view point parallel to the frame of reference of the screen a distance relative to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: Translate_2
method.description: Movement of the eye and the view point parallel to one of the axes of the fame of reference of the view a distance relative to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: Translate_1
method.description: Movement of the eye and view point parallel to the current axis a distance relative to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: Place
method.description: places the point of the view corresponding at the pixel position x,y at the center of the window and updates the view.

method.name: Turn_3
method.description: Rotation of the view point around the frame of reference of the screen for which the origin is the eye of the projection with a relative angular value in RADIANS with respect to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: Turn_2
method.description: Rotation of the view point around one of the axes of the frame of reference of the view for which the origin is the eye of the projection with an angular value in RADIANS relative to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: Turn_1
method.description: Rotation of the view point around the current axis an angular value in RADIANS relative to the initial position expressed by Start = Standard_True

method.name: SetTwist
method.description: Defines the angular position of the high point of the reference frame of the view with respect to the Y screen axis with an absolute angular value in RADIANS.

method.name: SetEye
method.description: Defines the position of the eye..

method.name: SetDepth
method.description: Defines the Depth of the eye from the view point without update the projection .

method.name: SetProj_2
method.description: Defines the orientation of the projection.

method.name: SetProj_1
method.description: Defines the orientation of the projection .

method.name: SetAt
method.description: Defines the position of the view point.

method.name: SetUp_2
method.description: Defines the orientation of the high point.

method.name: SetUp_1
method.description: Defines the orientation(SO) of the high point.

method.name: SetViewOrientationDefault
method.description: Saves the current state of the orientation of the view which will be the return state at ResetViewOrientation.

method.name: ResetViewOrientation
method.description: Resets the orientation of the view. Updates the view

method.name: Panning
method.description: Translates the center of the view along "x" and "y" axes of view projection. Can be used to perform interactive panning operation. In that case the DXv, DXy parameters specify panning relative to the point where the operation is started.

method.name: SetCenter
method.description: Relocates center of screen to the point, determined by {Xp, Yp} pixel coordinates relative to the bottom-left corner of screen. To calculate pixel coordinates for any point from world coordinate space, it can be projected using "Project".

method.name: SetSize
method.description: Defines the view projection size in its maximum dimension, keeping the initial height/width ratio unchanged.

method.name: SetZSize
method.description: Defines the Depth size of the view Front Plane will be set to Size/2. Back Plane will be set to -Size/2. Any Object located Above the Front Plane or behind the Back Plane will be Clipped . NOTE than the XY Size of the View is NOT modified .

method.name: SetZoom
method.description: Zooms the view by a factor relative to the initial value expressed by Start = Standard_True Updates the view.

method.name: SetScale
method.description: Zooms the view by a factor relative to the value initialised by SetViewMappingDefault(). Updates the view.

method.name: SetAxialScale
method.description: Sets anisotropic (axial) scale factors <Sx>, <Sy>, <Sz> for view <me>. Anisotropic scaling operation is performed through multiplying the current view orientation matrix by a scaling matrix: || Sx 0 0 0 || || 0 Sy 0 0 || || 0 0 Sz 0 || || 0 0 0 1 || Updates the view.

method.name: FitAll_1
method.description: Adjust view parameters to fit the displayed scene, respecting height / width ratio. The Z clipping range (depth range) is fitted if AutoZFit flag is TRUE. Throws program error exception if margin coefficient is < 0 or >= 1. Updates the view.

method.name: FitAll_2
method.description: Adjust view parameters to fit the displayed scene, respecting height / width ratio according to the custom bounding box given. Throws program error exception if margin coefficient is < 0 or >= 1. Updates the view.

method.name: DepthFitAll
method.description: Adjusts the viewing volume so as not to clip the displayed objects by front and back and back clipping planes. Also sets depth value automatically depending on the calculated Z size and Aspect parameter. NOTE than the original XY size of the view is NOT modified .

method.name: FitAll_3
method.description: Centers the defined projection window so that it occupies the maximum space while respecting the initial height/width ratio. NOTE than the original Z size of the view is NOT modified .

method.name: WindowFit
method.description: Centers the defined PIXEL window so that it occupies the maximum space while respecting the initial height/width ratio. NOTE than the original Z size of the view is NOT modified.

method.name: SetViewMappingDefault
method.description: Saves the current view mapping. This will be the state returned from ResetViewmapping.

method.name: ResetViewMapping
method.description: Resets the centering of the view. Updates the view

method.name: Convert_1
method.description: Converts the PIXEL value to a value in the projection plane.

method.name: Convert_3
method.description: Converts the point PIXEL into a point projected in the reference frame of the projection plane.

method.name: Convert_2
method.description: Converts tha value of the projection plane into a PIXEL value.

method.name: Convert_4
method.description: Converts the point defined in the reference frame of the projection plane into a point PIXEL.

method.name: Convert_5
method.description: Converts the projected point into a point in the reference frame of the view corresponding to the intersection with the projection plane of the eye/view point vector.

method.name: ConvertWithProj
method.description: Converts the projected point into a point in the reference frame of the view corresponding to the intersection with the projection plane of the eye/view point vector and returns the projection ray for further computations.

method.name: ConvertToGrid_1
method.description: Converts the projected point into the nearest grid point in the reference frame of the view corresponding to the intersection with the projection plane of the eye/view point vector and display the grid marker. Warning: When the grid is not active the result is identical to the above Convert() method. How to use: 1) Enable the grid echo display myViewer->SetGridEcho(Standard_True); 2) When application receive a move event: 2.1) Check if any object is detected if( myInteractiveContext->MoveTo(x,y) == AIS_SOD_Nothing ) { 2.2) Check if the grid is active if( myViewer->Grid()->IsActive() ) { 2.3) Display the grid echo and gets the grid point myView->ConvertToGrid(x,y,X,Y,Z); myView->Viewer()->ShowGridEcho (myView, Graphic3d_Vertex (X,Y,Z)); myView->RedrawImmediate(); 2.4) Else this is the standard case } else myView->Convert(x,y,X,Y,Z);

method.name: ConvertToGrid_2
method.description: Converts the point into the nearest grid point and display the grid marker.

method.name: Convert_6
method.description: Projects the point defined in the reference frame of the view into the projected point in the associated window.

method.name: Project_1
method.description: Converts the point defined in the user space of the view to the projection plane at the depth relative to theZ.

method.name: Project_2
method.description: Converts the point defined in the user space of the view to the projection plane at the depth relative to theZ.

method.name: BackgroundColor_2
method.description: Returns the Background color values of the view depending of the color Type.

method.name: BackgroundColor_1
method.description: Returns the Background color object of the view.

method.name: GradientBackgroundColors
method.description: Returns the gradient background colors of the view.

method.name: GradientBackground
method.description: Returns the gradient background of the view.

method.name: Scale
method.description: Returns the current value of the zoom expressed with respect to SetViewMappingDefault().

method.name: AxialScale_1
method.description: Returns the current values of the anisotropic (axial) scale factors.

method.name: Size
method.description: Returns the height and width of the view.

method.name: ZSize
method.description: Returns the Depth of the view .

method.name: Eye
method.description: Returns the position of the eye.

method.name: FocalReferencePoint
method.description: Returns the position of point which emanating the projections.

method.name: ProjReferenceAxe
method.description: Returns the coordinate of the point (Xpix,Ypix) in the view (XP,YP,ZP), and the projection vector of the view passing by the point (for PerspectiveView).

method.name: Depth
method.description: Returns the Distance between the Eye and View Point.

method.name: Proj
method.description: Returns the projection vector.

method.name: At
method.description: Returns the position of the view point.

method.name: Up
method.description: Returns the vector giving the position of the high point.

method.name: Twist
method.description: Returns in RADIANS the orientation of the view around the visual axis measured from the Y axis of the screen.

method.name: ShadingModel
method.description: Returns the current shading model; Graphic3d_TypeOfShadingModel_Phong by default.

method.name: SetShadingModel
method.description: Defines the shading model for the visualization.

method.name: Visualization
method.description: Returns the current visualisation mode.

method.name: ActiveLights
method.description: Returns a list of active lights.

method.name: ActiveLightIterator
method.description: Return iterator for defined lights.

method.name: LightLimit
method.description: Returns the MAX number of light associated to the view.

method.name: Viewer
method.description: Returns the viewer in which the view has been created.

method.name: IfWindow
method.description: Returns True if MyView is associated with a window .

method.name: Window
method.description: Returns the Aspect Window associated with the view.

method.name: Type
method.description: Returns the Type of the View

method.name: Pan
method.description: Translates the center of the view along "x" and "y" axes of view projection. Can be used to perform interactive panning operation. In that case the DXp, DXp parameters specify panning relative to the point where the operation is started.

method.name: Zoom
method.description: Zoom the view according to a zoom factor computed from the distance between the 2 mouse position.

method.name: StartZoomAtPoint
method.description: Defines starting point for ZoomAtPoint view operation.

method.name: ZoomAtPoint
method.description: Zooms the model at a pixel defined by the method StartZoomAtPoint().

method.name: AxialScale_2
method.description: Performs anisotropic scaling of <me> view along the given <Axis>. The scale factor is calculated on a basis of the mouse pointer displacement <Dx,Dy>. The calculated scale factor is then passed to SetAxialScale(Sx, Sy, Sz) method.

method.name: StartRotation
method.description: Begin the rotation of the view around the screen axis according to the mouse position <X,Y>. Warning: Enable rotation around the Z screen axis when <zRotationThreshold> factor is > 0 soon the distance from the start point and the center of the view is > (medium viewSize * <zRotationThreshold> ). Generally a value of 0.4 is usable to rotate around XY screen axis inside the circular threshold area and to rotate around Z screen axis outside this area.

method.name: Rotation
method.description: Continues the rotation of the view with an angle computed from the last and new mouse position <X,Y>.

method.name: SetFocale
method.description: Change View Plane Distance for Perspective Views Warning! raises TypeMismatch from Standard if the view is not a perspective view.

method.name: Focale
method.description: Returns the View Plane Distance for Perspective Views

method.name: View
method.description: Returns the associated Graphic3d view.

method.name: SetComputedMode
method.description: Switches computed HLR mode in the view.

method.name: ComputedMode
method.description: Returns the computed HLR mode state.

method.name: WindowFitAll
method.description: idem than WindowFit

method.name: FitMinMax
method.description: Transform camera eye, center and scale to fit in the passed bounding box specified in WCS.

method.name: SetGrid
method.description: Defines or Updates the definition of the grid in <me>

method.name: SetGridActivity
method.description: Defines or Updates the activity of the grid in <me>

method.name: ToPixMap_1
method.description: Dumps the full contents of the view to a pixmap with specified parameters. Internally this method calls Redraw() with an offscreen render buffer of requested target size (theWidth x theHeight), so that there is no need resizing a window control for making a dump of different size.

method.name: ToPixMap_2
method.description: Dumps the full contents of the view to a pixmap. Internally this method calls Redraw() with an offscreen render buffer of requested target size (theWidth x theHeight), so that there is no need resizing a window control for making a dump of different size.

method.name: SetBackFacingModel
method.description: Manages display of the back faces

method.name: BackFacingModel
method.description: Returns current state of the back faces display; Graphic3d_TypeOfBackfacingModel_Auto by default, which means that backface culling is defined by each presentation.

method.name: AddClipPlane
method.description: Adds clip plane to the view. The composition of clip planes truncates the rendering space to convex volume. Number of supported clip planes can be consulted by PlaneLimit method of associated Graphic3d_GraphicDriver. Please be aware that the planes which exceed the limit are ignored during rendering.

method.name: RemoveClipPlane
method.description: Removes clip plane from the view.

method.name: ClipPlanes
method.description: Get clip planes.

method.name: SetClipPlanes
method.description: Sets sequence of clip planes to the view. The planes that have been set before are removed from the view. The composition of clip planes truncates the rendering space to convex volume. Number of supported clip planes can be consulted by InquirePlaneLimit method of Graphic3d_GraphicDriver. Please be aware that the planes that exceed the limit are ignored during rendering.

method.name: PlaneLimit
method.description: Returns the MAX number of clipping planes associated to the view.

method.name: SetCamera
method.description: Change camera used by view.

method.name: Camera
method.description: Returns camera object of the view.

method.name: DefaultCamera
method.description: Return default camera.

method.name: RenderingParams
method.description: Returns current rendering parameters and effect settings. By default it returns default parameters of current viewer. To define view-specific settings use method V3d_View::ChangeRenderingParams().

method.name: ChangeRenderingParams
method.description: Returns reference to current rendering parameters and effect settings.

method.name: SetFrustumCulling
method.description: Turn on/off automatic culling of objects outside frustum (ON by default)

method.name: GravityPoint
method.description: Returns the Objects number and the gravity center of ALL viewable points in the view

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: IsSubview
method.description: Return TRUE if this is a subview of another view.

method.name: AddSubview
method.description: Add subview to the list.

method.name: IfMoreLights
method.description: Returns True if One light more can be activated in this View.

method.name: InitActiveLights
method.description: initializes an iteration on the active Lights.

method.name: MoreActiveLights
method.description: returns true if there are more active Light(s) to return.

method.name: NextActiveLights
method.description: Go to the next active Light (if there is not, ActiveLight will raise an exception)
